    About this scene

    This runs the same worker, construction and animal-care simulation as the Simulation page. The timeline shows hourly snapshots using static state models. Positions and worn paths come from the simulation; the hex is only a display boundary. The downloaded artifact keeps asset references, the selected simulation frame, theme and boundary separate for later game use.
